severity_contract: kill = the unit cannot ship as written. major = a second defensible answer, a false key, or a claim in the shipping record that is untrue on bytes. minor = a live defect in student-visible or key-visible prose, or a record-keeping gap about a live defect; non-blocking, cheap fix named. note = a structural residual held non-blocking under standing bank policy or precedent, recorded so it is not rediscovered. info = coverage record, no action.
scope_note: V-FINAL adversarial audit of batch19 unit las-b19-003 (”Yrket efter namnet i Ledingsbos katalog”, LÄS essä short, 2q, family telefonkatalogens-yrkestitlar-essa-short) on the shipping bytes of batches/batch19/candidates/las-b19-003.json as of 2026-09-01, post fleet-repair-1 and fleet-repair-3. Prime directive was to REFUTE. Specifically: to break the REBUILT q1 option B, to show the B⊨D entailment that G-STEM r1 killed had survived or reappeared in a new guise, to rescue q1-A or q2-C/D as a second defensible answer, to catch the repair_log or the NOTES claiming something untrue on bytes, to falsify the corrected q2-A paragraph reference, and to find a real-world bearer for any of the three invented names. Both questions have exactly one defensible answer on the passage (D, B); the B/D entailment is genuinely broken and the rebuilt B is refuted at an explicit locus the old B did not have; every repair_log and NOTES §11/§12 claim verifies byte-exact, including all twelve paragraph references and every rationale quotation; all six mechanical gates re-pass on shipping bytes against 114 shipped units; and a full LAW 16 re-run with a passing positive control returns zero for every kept name on sv.wikipedia exact-phrase, Nominatim SE and a second index, with all three honest rejections reproducing exactly. What I did find: a blind route that reaches BOTH keys (form on q1, cross-question inference on q2) and therefore exceeds the floor NOTES §6 declares; two live items the fleet-repair-3 record fails to carry; one NEW numeric tension in the passage that no gate raised; and a register/registry texture proximity tighter than the batch18 precedent it is filed under. findings.claim: The sheet's real blind exposure is above the floor NOTES §6 declares. q1 remains form-walkable to key D after the option-B rebuild, and a cross-question content route then carries the solver from q1 to q2's key B. NOTES §6 states an ”adversarial blind floor: 1-in-2 per question” and ”No cross-question bridge exists (§4), so the sheet cannot be walked from 1-in-2 to better.” The second half of that is too strong.
findings.evidence: q1 leg, reproduced independently this round on the stems sheet before reading the passage: A and D are explicit contradictories on one axis (who the occupational word came from — föreningens kassör vs abonnenten), while B (what the strike-throughs mean) and C (what the printed form offered) sit off that axis. The key is therefore inside {A, D} by form. Within the pair, D carries two qualifiers (”i regel” plus the scope clause ”där skriften gick att jämföra”) against A's single perception hedge (”tycks”), and a doubly-qualified, methodologically-scoped statement is the canonical key shape for a ”what did she find in the archive” stem. My cold options-only pick was D at roughly 70 percent confidence. This reproduces G-STEM r1 (”BLIND: PARTIALLY, pick=D”) and G-STEM r2 post-rebuild (”BLIND: PARTIALLY / pick D … A and D remain an explicit contradictory pair … and D is the more heavily qualified member”). q2 leg (cross-question): q1's own option set names the association-control hypotheses twice, in A (the association's cashier wrote the titles) and C (the printed form listed the permitted designations). A solver who has taken q1=D — subscriber-control — can reconstruct from those two distractors what the essayist's ”misstanke” in q2's stem must have been, and the only stance consistent with a subscriber-control finding is abandonment, i.e. q2 B. NOTES §4's sentence ”Q1's key cannot corroborate Q2's key even conceptually: a blind solver reading Q2 alone cannot tell which explanation is 'den vanliga'” is scoped to reading Q2 ALONE and is correct at that scope; it does not bound the sheet read whole, which is what the rule-11 sweep is for.
findings.why: Held at note, not major, on four checked grounds. (1) Standing bank policy: the batch16 ägardom carried down the BRIEF-ADDENDUM lineage rules cross-question stance/axis correlation REPORTABLE AT NOTE SEVERITY and non-blocking provided the adversarial blind floor is stated, and the las-b18-003 V-FINAL filed an identical shape at note one batch ago. (2) The route is walkable but demonstrably not compelling: G-STEM r1 walked it and declared the routes to DISAGREE (”the item is not decided blind”), and G-STEM r2's independent blind leg on q2 landed on D — the wrong answer — and recorded ”NOT_ANSWERABLE / pick null (soft lean D)”. Two independent legs plus my own soft lean to D make the bridge a possibility, not a shortcut. (3) The q1 leg is within RULE 10 as written: A is hedged too, so the ”pick the qualified one” heuristic narrows to {A, D} = 1-in-2 exactly as §6 claims, and the key is hedged in 1 of 2 questions, at the ceiling and not over it (verified mechanically: q2 carries no hedged option at all, so that heuristic has zero traction there). (4) On the passage both keys are uniquely defensible, so the leak costs discrimination, not correctness. Recorded in sharper form than the unit's own NOTES record it, so a later reader does not take §6 at face value.

findings.claim: NEW, raised by no gate: the passage carries a numeric tension a student can compute in one step. ¶1 states eleven catalogues across 1907–1931; ¶2 states the form came round ”vartannat år”. A strictly biennial series across that span yields thirteen issues, not eleven.
findings.evidence: ¶1: ”Ledingsbo telefonförening gav ut elva kataloger mellan 1907 och 1931.” ¶2: ”tillfället kom vartannat år, när blanketten skulle fyllas i på nytt.” 1907, 1909 … 1931 inclusive = 13 issues; eleven issues over 24 years is a mean interval of 2.4 years. ¶4 sharpens rather than settles it: ”avgiftstabellen trycktes om oförändrad både 1919 och 1926” — 1919 sits on the 1907-anchored odd-year biennial grid, 1926 cannot sit on it at all. Six other numbers in the unit do reconcile and were checked: 14 handlande + 2 fabrikörer = 16 title-bearers in the first catalogue against 3 + 9 + 11 = 23 in the last, which is consistent with ”utan att särskilt många nya rörelser hade öppnat” under the passage's own hedge; the 1938 and 1949 catalogues sit outside the eleven-catalogue window, which ¶1 scopes to the period in which the yrkesord moved; 412 subscribers in 1949 is unconstrained by anything else in the text.
findings.why: Minor and explicitly non-blocking. The passage supplies its own evidence that the cycle was irregular (1919 and 1926 are seven years apart), so ”vartannat år” reads as approximate and the figures reconcile at ~2.4-year mean spacing — this is how real directory series behave. Decisively, no question, option, key or rationale turns on the count: q1 asks who wrote the word, q2 what she concludes. Filed at minor rather than note because integrated-review names ”a number that won't reconcile” as its own target and this one is one subtraction away from a student. Cheap fix, one word, in student-facing prose: ”tillfället kom ungefär vartannat år” (or ”vartannat eller vart tredje år”). Blast radius: passage only, requiring a mechanical re-copy of blind/las-b19-003.json and distractor/las-b19-003.json; no option, key, rationale, stem or sheet-structure change, and no re-blind.

findings.claim: The las-b17-003 lane-echo disposition is UPHELD, but the echo is one move tighter than G-REGISTER's written disposition names, and the binding forward note should be carried forward with a third clause.
findings.evidence: G-REGISTER r1 and r2 both tolerated the echo with las-b17-003 (”Tjugo sidor anvisningar”) at minor, on the ground that the outcome is INVERTED and the thesis shape is new to the lane. I read b17-003 in full and confirm both: its author holds her reading against Bråtemo (”Just därför säger de något, nämligen att förändringen var avsiktlig”), where b19-003's concedes to Rämnestad (”Jag får ge Rämnestad rätt”), and conventional-view-confirmed does not appear elsewhere in the lane. Not named in either disposition: BOTH units close on the series' LAST ISSUE with its contents ENUMERATED. b17-003: ”Det sista häftet i Bråtemos samling är från 1958 … Det innehåller elva påståenden, en ordlista och en enda fråga.” b19-003: ”Sidan hade därefter tre kolumner: nummer, namn, adress. Föreningen tryckte sin sista egna katalog 1949, med fyrahundratolv abonnenter.” That is the same closing MOVE, not merely the same subject matter, and it is a third shared element beside the serial printed ephemeron and the counted proportion shifting across decades.

Recorded so the forward note is not carried forward in its weaker form. RECOMMENDED forward note for the next essä short, strengthening G-REGISTER's: it must not (a) run a counted proportion in a serial printed corpus, (b) open on a count, or (c) close on the series' last issue with its contents enumerated.

findings.claim: The strongest counsel's case against key q1-D, put on the record so it is not rediscovered: the cashier mechanism is killed by a doubly-qualified observation but summarised flatly, which leaves q1-A under-refuted for a reader who stops at ¶4.
findings.evidence: The ONLY anti-cashier evidence in the archive paragraph is scoped twice: ”I de fall där skriften gick att jämföra med annat i mappen härrörde yrkesordet i regel från abonnenten själv.” The passage never states what fraction of the ~300 slips were comparable. q1-A reads ”Att titlarna i de flesta fall tycks vara nedskrivna av föreningens egen kassör” — which is not strictly excluded by ¶4 alone if comparability was rare. It is ¶5 that closes it: ”Ingen av mina tre mekanismer fanns alltså”, a flat denial in the author's own voice covering all three hypotheses including the cashier. By contrast the other two mechanisms are killed by unhedged evidence, one each: the approved-list by ”Titelraden var tom på den tryckta blanketten: ingen lista över godkända ord, ingen anvisning om längd”, and the fee by ”Avgiften var densamma vare sig raden fylldes med ett ord eller med fem”.
findings.why: Note, and NOT a second defensible answer, on the stem's own wording. The stem asks what the essayist FANN. A is not among her findings under any reading of the passage — she reports the opposite appearance and then denies the mechanism outright — while D is what the text states she found. So A is refuted at the assertion level even where the underlying inference is generous, and D remains unique. Recorded because this asymmetry is exactly what makes A a good hedged foil rather than a rival, and because it is the only route by which a strong reader could hesitate; a later reader should meet it here rather than re-derive it.

findings.claim: Glossary scope: the two glossed words are the two least load-bearing of the four period trade terms. ”fabrikör” and ”hemmansägare” are glossed; ”handlande” and ”köpman”, which carry the passage's entire premise, are not.
findings.evidence: Glossary block: ”fabrikör = äldre titel för ägaren av en mindre fabrik eller verkstad” and ”hemmansägare = ägare av en bondgård med egen jord”. Both verified present in the passage (fabrikör twice in ¶1; hemmansägarna in ¶5). The title-inflation premise the whole essay rests on is the prestige gradient handlande → köpman/fabrikör, shown by the ¶1 counts (14→3 handlande, 0→9 köpmän, 2→11 fabrikörer). ”handlande” as a count noun is the least transparent of the three and is momentarily readable as the present participle; it is unglossed.
findings.why: Info, no action. Authentic HP LÄS passages carry unglossed period vocabulary; the NOTES' self-imposed rule (”defines only in-passage words”) is honoured; the trim to two entries was a deliberate law-15 surface-variety move against batch18's three; and no question depends on the gradient, since q1 asks who wrote the word and q2 what the essayist concludes. Recorded only so the choice reads as examined rather than incidental.

resolved_findings.id: G-STEM r1 q:1 major — q1-B was the absolutised twin of key D (B ⊨ D, plus the absolutizer ”varje”)
resolved_findings.status: RESOLVED — verified on bytes and re-litigated cold, which was this audit's headline assignment
resolved_findings.was: Old q1-B: ”Att titeln på varje bevarad blankett var skriven av abonnenten själv.” G-STEM r1: ”'varje' is a universal, and B is the absolutised twin of D: B entails D, so B cannot be a uniquely correct key and the qualified twin becomes the standing favourite.”
resolved_findings.resolution: Fixed and verified three ways. BYTES: questions[0].options[1].text is EXACTLY the repair_log's declared to-text, ”Att de överstrukna orden i ett tjugotal fall var rättelser av felläsningar.”; the string ”varje” appears in no option of either question. ENTAILMENT, re-derived from scratch rather than taken from the log: new B is about what the ~20 strike-throughs MEAN, D about whose the occupational word WAS in the comparable subset. Neither entails the other in either direction; they are not even on the same scope (a ~20-case subset vs an ”i regel” generalisation over the comparable cases), and they are jointly satisfiable, so no strength-variant pair remains. I pushed the one route that could reintroduce entailment — 'a correction of a misreading presupposes a subscriber original, therefore B ⊨ D' — and it fails, and in fact leans the other way: a misreading correction ON the slip implies someone transcribed onto the slip, which points AWAY from subscriber authorship, not toward it. REFUTATION: the new B is refuted at an explicit locus the old B did not have — ¶5 ”Och överstrykningarna kan lika gärna vara ändrade beslut som rättelser av en felläsning – materialet svarar inte på det” — so against a stem asking what she FANN, B asserts a determinate finding the text expressly declines to make. G-KEY r2 legs A and B both independently identified B as the strongest wrong answer on exactly this ground. The rebuild is a strict improvement: it removed an entailment and installed a genuine premature-closure trap for the reader who stops at ¶4, where the strike-throughs are stated without their caveat.
